fluff.overview: Clan doctrine generally treats conventional infantry as a necessary evil, though Clans like Hell's Horses have demonstrated that properly supported infantry can be an effective component of combined-arms operations. Motorized Points ride light vehicles or motorcycles that provide faster movement than foot infantry without the heavier logistical requirements of fully mechanized formations. They trade protection for speed, making them effective as screening forces and rapid-response elements but vulnerable when caught in sustained engagements. Armed with Bearhunter superheavy autocannons, these warriors carry crew-served ballistic weapons that deliver firepower well beyond what personal arms can achieve, threatening light vehicles and battle armor at effective range.
